questions.prompt: [20] Describe what you see in the picture of a sandy beach beside the sea, with a colourful umbrella, gentle waves and a clear sky. Write at least 5–8 sentences in 5 minutes.
questions.explanation: Writing about images tests descriptive language skills.
questions.photoAlt: Illustration of a beach with an umbrella and the sea
questions.modelAnswer: A strong written response answers the prompt fully with a clear structure. For “Describe what you see in the picture of a sandy beach beside the sea, with a colourful umbrella, gentle waves and a clear sky. Write at least 5–8 sentences in 5 minutes.”, you might say: “Education reform and lifelong learning is something I have thought about. In my experience, … For example, … Overall, I believe ….” Aim for 3–5 well-organised sentences with specific details and accurate grammar.

questions.prompt: [21] Look at the picture of a modern open-plan office where people work at desks with computers, plants and large windows. You have 20 seconds to prepare, then speak for up to 90 seconds describing what you see and what you think is happening.
questions.explanation: Speaking about images tests descriptive and observational language.
questions.photoAlt: Illustration of an open-plan office with desks and computers
questions.modelAnswer: A strong spoken response answers the prompt fully with a clear structure. For “Look at the picture of a modern open-plan office where people work at desks with computers, plants and large windows. You have 20 seconds to prepare, then speak for up to 90 seconds describing what you see and what you think is happening.”, you might say: “Education reform and lifelong learning is something I have thought about. In my experience, … For example, … Overall, I believe ….” Aim for 30–50 seconds of fluent speech with specific details and accurate grammar.

questions.prompt: [22] Summarise the reading and give your opinion on whether your city should invest more in cycling infrastructure.
